description: This Java class 'CommandAndControlClient' is part of the Eclipse Hono project and serves as a client component for handling command and control operations over AMQP. It establishes connections, creates receivers and senders, processes incoming commands, and sends responses within an AMQP messaging setup.

classes.name: CommandAndControlClient
classes.description: A Spring component that manages connections and message exchanges over AMQP for command and control functionalities in Hono.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the client, sets up the command receiver, and handles incoming command messages.

methods.name: startCommandReceiver
methods.description: Establishes an AMQP connection and creates a receiver link to listen for command messages.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Opens a receiver link on the specified endpoint to receive commands, setting the message handler.
